newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks trade sideways on lack of news.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks trade sideways on lack of news.

text.p: Caracas stocks traded sideways on a lack of news, traders said, as investors waited on further developments in the slated privatization of telephone company CANTV.
"We'll see more action when we know better how the CANTV sale will be organized," said Vencred broker Geronimo Paolini.
The government's remaining 49 percent stake in CANTV is due to be sold in a global offering in November, with an as yet undetermined percentage reserved for the Caracas bolsa.
The market's 19-share .IBC index closed at 5,960.92 points, down 0.03 percent from Monday's end.
Over 16 million shares traded worth 2.5 billion bolivars ($5.3 million). Among traded issues, 16 rose, 11 fell and nine closed flat.
"It was a quiet market with only moderate volume," said Paolini.
